description: npm dependencies via Renovate (Dependabot cannot run pnpm 12 in its sandbox); GitHub Actions stay with Dependabot.

packageRules.description: Effect's packages must move in lockstep (a mismatch breaks the platform layer), and its http, http-api and ai modules may change in a minor: one PR of their own. @effect/tsgo follows oxlint and TypeScript instead.
Node types follow the Node 24 runtime pinned in .node-version.
